results.title: Parity: with only pre-change history (no rotation snapshots) the next group equals the legacy counter for 0-8 completed Giant B, and drafts and other templates are ignored exactly as before
Starting Giant B writes an additive rotation snapshot (group, slots, presented methods); other templates get none; the snapshot equals what is displayed
A Giant B whose presented intensifiers were performed credits its group: the groups then rotate 0,1,2,0,1,2 exactly as before for an athlete who performs them

A finished Giant B in which the presented intensifier was SKIPPED (straight work only) earns no credit: the same group is offered at the next Giant B, and the finished session still counts as a session
A partially done intensifier earns nothing: Myo-Reps with one effort cannot be saved, and a session that finishes after that attempt does not credit the group
Credit policy "any": if a group presents two intensifier slots and only one is performed, the group is credited (the other method waits for the group to come round again)
Interrupted then resumed: a draft that performed the intensifier is credited ONCE; resuming (even after a reload) shows the same methods, and finishing does not credit again
Interrupted before any intensifier: no credit, no lapse count; resuming keeps the same snapshot
No duplicate credit: duplicated session objects and duplicated records (as from a merged restore) credit a group once
Lapse (decision R4 = 2): a group that two consecutive finished sessions presented but nobody performed is moved back, so rotation can never be blocked and the same method is not offered forever
Busy week and COMPACT hide or suppress the intensifier: the session finishes and counts, but the group is not credited
Other templates never move the Giant B rotation, even when they perform intensifiers (Giant B Upper/Lower, Giant A)
A manual intensifier on a slot OUTSIDE the presented group does not credit any group
Legacy history then new sessions: pre-change completed Giant B keep their legacy meaning (no re-judging), and the new era continues from them
Order and clock independence: the derived group does not depend on array order of sessions; every session is judged on its own snapshot
Derivation is read-only and preserves history: calling it writes nothing; legacy sessions and every earlier record stay byte-identical after new sessions

Backup round trip and validation: a session carrying a rotation snapshot restores identically; malformed snapshots (bad group, slots that do not match the group, unknown method, extra keys, markup) are refused
A Giant B started on an older install (draft without a snapshot) resumes safely: no snapshot is invented, the legacy group is displayed, and finishing keeps the legacy credit
Full Session prescriptions unchanged: Giant B set counts per slot and the base slot table are untouched by rotation
One Skip control per displayed exercise of a lifting template (labelled), none on checklist templates; nothing else in the workout screen changes
Skipping records ONLY a flag on the draft session: no work-set, strength, activator, stretch or cardio record is created, and no set is checked
Skip is reversible while the session is a draft
An exercise with logged sets cannot be skipped (nothing is changed, the athlete is told); logging a set on a skipped exercise lifts the skip, so a record always wins
All four execution states in one session: performed, explicitly skipped, partially performed, unmarked gap (skipped, not marked) and not reached; no sets invented
Deliberate skip vs interruption: an explicitly skipped exercise AFTER the last logged one is "skipped", whereas the untouched ones after it are "not reached"
Skipping never makes a session full, never reduces what was prescribed and never fabricates performed sets; skipping everything with no logged work is "none"
Skipping the presented intensifier never credits or advances the Giant B rotation, and logs no intensifier record
A skip survives a reload and resume, and a backup round trip
Validator: skips must be {slot index: true} for slots that exist; anything else is refused with a specific message
A finished session cannot be re-skipped, and the Finish preview and notice name explicit skips as "skipped" (not "not reached")
budgetExposure(): per bar, the sessions split into full / partial / none / not recorded, with sets logged and checklist items ticked kept as separate units
The bars themselves are unchanged: budgetData() still counts every completed session once per category it belongs to, whatever its completion
Budget page: a full and a partial Strength session are told apart under the bar; the line reports logged sets and flags earlier sessions as not recorded; no combined total is shown
Units are never mixed: checklist sessions report checklist items, lifting sessions report sets, and neither is converted into the other
Coach Handoff carries the same logged-exposure lines (sessions with their completion split, and the unit-specific work logged); no bar means no line
Classification unchanged: Giant C stays Capability, the six ambiguous templates stay unclassified and are still disclosed as not counted; they never get a logged-exposure line
Only completed sessions from the last 7 days count; drafts and old sessions are excluded from bars and from exposure alike
Reporting is read-only and does not alter any record
Tag-lookalike text that no HTML element could be built from (<Z2>, <easy>, "HR <Z2> and <Z3>") is accepted by backup validation in every cardio field, exactly as stored
The same text can be logged through the cardio form and is stored exactly as typed (logging and import judge text identically)
A historical cardio record containing such text restores from a backup file byte-for-byte, through the real preview and restore buttons
Real HTML is still refused at import AND at logging: every real element name, comments, processing instructions, doctype, CDATA, and lookalikes that nest a real element
A lookalike carrying ANY attribute or tag-syntax trick (event handlers, bare attributes, slash tricks, tab-separated attributes, custom-element names) is refused
Stored lookalike text is inert wherever the app can show it: literal text in the cardio PREVIOUS line and no element anywhere in the document is ever created from it
Judging text never executes or loads it: validating real-HTML payloads sets no flag and makes no network request
Nothing else about import validation is relaxed: control characters, over-long text, bad keys and non-text values are still refused, and < or > is still refused in every other record type
Original data is preserved: refusing a file with real HTML changes nothing; restoring a lookalike file does not rewrite or escape any value; existing cardio history is untouched by validation
An exercise omitted from the latest session (no records) leaves its series untouched and never reads as deterioration
A partial exposure with fewer sets at the same load carries the same evidence as a full one (best performed set per exposure)
Legitimate evidence from a partial workout is preserved: a real workout in which only ONE exercise was done (all its sets logged) adds that exercise's exposure to its series, and nothing else
Skipped and not-reached exercises leave no record, so they cannot enter any series or be read as deterioration
Structured intensifier blocks never enter the evidence series, so an incomplete or smaller cluster cannot read as decline
Nothing in the engine raises a load automatically: the decision only reports OBSERVE / INVESTIGATE / ACT about a decline, and a single exposure never changes the program
